status: planned descriptive post-hoc analysis; designed after smoke results while main colored arm runs
origin: assistant: inspect executed behavior and short-step model error without privileged counterfactual data
inputs: the four conditions and all twenty tracks already in the frozen primary report
metrics: per-track action changes between consecutive real decisions, separately by control channel
per-track absolute chosen-minus-base correction and override rate, where logged
one-step body-velocity vector RMSE and yaw-rate RMSE only for full four-frame executed actions, where logged
aggregation: equal-weight track means; descriptive only; no new significance testing
limits: closed-loop state distributions differ; no causal attribution of failure
one-step error is not horizon prediction accuracy or candidate rank/regret
no unexecuted candidate outcomes, extra simulator calls or changed primary endpoints
design followed smoke outcomes and is not preregistered confirmatory analysis
timestamp_source: filesystem creation-write mtime captured before metadata correction
